enrichment.headline: Adds $42,641.04 and time for Mayekawa USA's refrigeration walkthrough and training at The Center
enrichment.summary: Adds a final walkthrough, inspection and follow-up training for the newly installed refrigeration system at The Center Project. The contract limit rises from $7,805.00 to $50,446.04, and the term is extended from December 31, 2022 to June 30, 2023. The original term ended before this vote.

enrichment.headline: Awards Deco Tech Systems $240,500 for security cameras and door intercoms at Oakland High
enrichment.summary: Deco Tech Systems, the lowest responsive, responsible bidder, will install, replace and repair security cameras (about 4 new, 102 replacements and 5 repairs) and add a door entry intercom system at Oakland High School. The $240,500.00 includes a $21,500.00 contingency allowance. Work is expected to start January 18, 2023 and last 90 days, ending around April 17, 2023.
